approval_evidence.quote: Drug Approval Package: BETASERON INTERFERON BETA-1B SUBCUTANEOUS COMPANY: CHIRON CORPORATION; application number 103471; approval date 07/23/1993 (Drugs@FDA pre-1996 approval package)

series_start_reason: Series starts 2000Q4, the first quarter Schering AG's published reports allow to be isolated. Schering AG (CIK 1124139), the maker of Betaferon/Betaseron before Bayer, registered with the SEC in September 2000 and filed its interim reports as Forms 6-K: the report for the first nine months of 2000 (filed 2000-10-30) prints Betaferon at 440 and the preliminary results for 2000 (filed 2001-02-07) print full-year 2000 at 593, so the fourth quarter of 2000 is 153; the first three quarters of 2000 are printed only as one nine-month figure, so no earlier single quarter exists. From 2001 Schering prints the first quarter, the first half, nine months and the full year, from which every quarter follows. Bayer acquired Schering AG (control June 23, 2006; the 6-K for the first nine months of 2006 was still filed by Schering AG) and prints the line itself from the Annual Report 2006; the fourth quarter of 2006 is Bayer's pro forma full year for the Schering product less Schering's nine months. Betaseron was FDA approved on 1993-07-23 (the application was then held by Chiron); no document read dates the first sale, and no document before September 2000 was found.
series_end_reason: From the Quarterly Statement Q1 2025 on, Bayer's Best-Selling Pharmaceuticals Products table (A 8) no longer has a Betaferon/Betaseron row: its 15 printed rows are Eylea, Xarelto, Nubeqa, Mirena/Kyleena/Jaydess, Aspirin Cardio, YAZ/Yasmin/Yasminelle, Adempas, Kerendia, Kovaltry/Jivi, Adalat, CT Fluid Delivery, Ultravist, Gadovist, Stivarga, Glucobay, then Total (the whole Q1 2025 document was read; Betaferon/Betaseron appears nowhere in it). The earlier search also found no Betaferon/Betaseron row in the Q2 2025, Q3 2025, Annual Report 2025, Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 reports. The last printed quarter is Q4 2024 (Annual Report 2024).
notes: Bayer Group worldwide Betaferon (EU) / Betaseron (U.S.) sales on one line, EUR million. Scope proof: the Best-Selling Pharmaceuticals Products table has no region column; in the 2016 to 2018 reports every product row is followed by an 'of which U.S.A.' sub-row (read in the Annual Report 2016 table), which makes the product row the all-region total. The row label and the values are unchanged when that sub-row is dropped from the 2019 reports onward. Printed label is 'Betaferon/Betaseron' without spaces in the Q1 2014 report, 'Betaferon / Betaseron' with spaces from the Q2 2014 report up to the Q3 2021 report and 'Betaferon/Betaseron' from the Annual Report 2021 on; row_label follows the printed spelling. Quarters 2013Q1 to 2013Q3 are read from prior-year columns of the 2014 interim reports because Bayer's 2013 interim reports are not in the public archive; 2012Q4 and 2013Q4 to 2024Q4 are read from the report that publishes the quarter as current. The Annual Report 2015 prior-year columns print Q4 2014 as 191 and full-year 2014 as 823 against 190 and 819 in the Annual Report 2014; the current-report figures are used. Quarterly figures sum to the printed full-year figures: 2013 1,038, 2014 819, 2015 824, 2016 734, 2017 651, 2018 544, 2019 457, 2020 404, 2021 337, 2022 311, 2023 232, 2024 192 (EUR million); 2012 full year is 1,216 against the single printed quarter 329. Extension to 2000Q4-2012Q3: through 2006Q3 the rows are Schering AG's worldwide top-selling-products line (EUR million, the 2001 reports footnote 'Trade name in the USA and Canada: Betaseron'), which Schering prints only cumulatively (first quarter, first half, nine months, full year), so Q2, Q3 and Q4 are derived by subtraction of the earlier cumulative figures and Q1 is read directly. From 2007Q1 to 2012Q3 the rows are Bayer's Best-Selling Pharmaceutical Products table: Q1-Q3 from the quarter's own newsletter, Q4 as the annual-report full year less the nine-month figure (the annual reports to 2010 print no fourth-quarter column), except 2011Q4, read from the prior-year column of the Annual Report 2012. Full-year sums agree with the printed annual figures for every year: 2001 681, 2002 783, 2003 770, 2004 782, 2005 867, 2006 991 (pro forma), 2007 1,028, 2008 1,144, 2009 1,214, 2010 1,206, 2011 1,117 (EUR million). The Bayer newsletters of 2007 to 2012 are on bayer.com, which answers HTTP 403 to automated downloads; they were read through the Parallel web_fetch tool, which returns the text of the bayer.com PDF itself. The annual-report rows cite annualreports.com copies of the Bayer annual reports 2006 to 2010. Bayer's quarterly figures for 2013Q1-2013Q3 already in the series were left as they were (read from the 2014 prior-year columns); Bayer's own 2013 newsletters print 254, 269 and 256 for those quarters, the same values.
search_log: bayer.com answers HTTP 403 to direct requests from this environment (curl with the project User-Agent), so every bayer.com PDF cited here was read through the Parallel Search web_fetch tool, which returned the text of the bayer.com PDF itself. The rows citing reports.bayer.com (Annual Report 2025, Q1 2026, Q2 2026) and the sitecorecontenthub copy of the 2020 Half-Year Report were fetched directly and checked by the verifier.

Report archive: bayer.com/en/investors/quarterly-reports lists the Q1, Q2 and Q3 financial reports for 2014 to 2026 (2016 and 2015 included) and says reports before 2014 are available through Investor Downloads or the IR team; the earlier note that 2016-and-earlier reports were not located was wrong. Interim Reports 2013 (Q1 to Q3) were not found in the public archive.

Quarters before 2017 were read in this pass: Interim Reports Q1 to Q3 2014, 2015 and 2016, Annual Reports 2012 to 2016 (Best-Selling Pharmaceuticals Products tables, Betaferon/Betaseron is a row in every one).

Every quarter from 2013Q4 is read from the report that publishes it as current: first-quarter statements, half-year reports (Q2 column), third-quarter statements, and the Annual Report for Q4. The following year's prior-year columns were compared with the values used: the only difference found is Q4 2014 (190 in the Annual Report 2014, 191 in the Annual Report 2015).

Sum check: the four quarters of each year 2013 to 2024 equal the full-year figure printed in the Annual Report's Best-Selling Pharmaceuticals Products table (and, for 2022-2024, the 'Sales by Product - Pharmaceuticals' segment note).

End of series: read the Betaferon/Betaseron row through the Annual Report 2024 (Q4 2024 57 48; 2024 232 192). Read the complete Quarterly Statement Q1 2025 (text of the whole document, table A 8 listed row by row in series_end_reason): no Betaferon/Betaseron row and no mention of the product. Checked earlier the Pharmaceuticals best-selling tables of the Q2 2025 and Q3 2025 reports (the row after Stivarga is Glucobay), the Annual Report 2025 (best-selling table and segment note B 4/6 by product; extracted text of the whole PDF has no Betaferon line with a figure), and the Q1 2026 and Q2 2026 reports (Stivarga then Glucobay). Bayer prints no figure for the product after 2024.
Partner/royalty fallback (Novartis distributes the U.S. Extavia, not Betaseron): no other issuer prints Betaseron net sales; not pursued further.

Extension pass. Looked before 2000Q4: the 6-K of 2000-10-30 (nine months 2000) and the preliminary results of 2000 are the first Schering documents on EDGAR (Form 20-FR12B filed 2000-09-27); the first nine months of 2000 are one figure (440, +33%), so quarters 2000Q1-2000Q3 cannot be separated. Checked 2013Q1-2013Q3 in Bayer's own newsletters: Q1 2013 254 (ab-q1-2013-en.pdf), Q2 2013 269 (ab-q2-2013-en.pdf), Q3 2013 256 (ab-q3-2013-en_0.pdf); identical to the gold rows, which were left untouched.

reviewed_anomalies.2006Q4: Issuer changes from Schering AG to Bayer. Bayer's own Annual Report 2006 line for Betaferon/Betaseron (535) counts Schering AG's sales only from June 23, 2006; the quarter is therefore taken from the pro forma Schering AG product line (991 for the year) less Schering AG's reported nine months (727), which equals 264. The same full-quarter basis is used for 2006Q2 and 2006Q3 by Schering AG's own 6-K reports (249 and 246), and Bayer's pro forma comparatives for those quarters (249 and 246) agree.
reviewed_anomalies.2012Q2: Read at source: Bayer's second-quarter 2012 report attributes the rise (319 against 273 a year earlier) to price increases and the release of provisions for discounts in the United States. Kept as printed.
reviewed_anomalies.2000Q4: Derived from a full-year figure (593, stated in prose) less the nine-month table figure (440); the quarter includes the first Japanese sales (Betaferon was introduced in Japan in the fourth quarter of 2000, per the same release).
